architecture_review.module: Windows Explorer native gallery presentation adapter
reused_existing_logic: Existing snapshot/PIDL type and status semantics; navigation/selection/refresh owner callbacks.
Root-provided generated Web semantic COLORREF theme; no separately maintained palette.
One bounded AccessibleModel for painting, MSAA and native UIA.
Ready navigation UIA descriptions reuse snapshot::TypeText; non-ready descriptions retain snapshot::StatusText unchanged.
Horizontal navigation uses current bounds/order and existing Next/Previous fallback; Up/Down spatial semantics are unchanged.
Caller-provided View.UpdateStatus text is presented unchanged in a standard STATIC using existing font/theme; Surface does not duplicate counting.
cross_module_access: Public snapshot projection and Surface callbacks only; no core tables, permissions, network or media decode.
new_major_dependencies: Only Windows system GDI/msimg32/oleacc/uiautomationcore, root approved ADR-0021.
contract_changes: Root-approved Surface callbacks providerLifetimeOwner and complete visible-files API; no shared wire/DB contract edited by this owner.
Root-approved UI-only Surface::SetStatusText API, 256 UTF16-unit bound and stable STATIC child ID106; wire/permission contracts unchanged.
